title: Derived verification record/data shapes; not authority or runtime conformance
description: Use DATA-CONTRACT.md for cross-record and trust semantics. Reject duplicate keys/invalid tokens before schema validation. All $refs are local.

F-X.value_token: JSON integer token with decoded integer 0..255; exclude Boolean, decimal and exponent forms
F-X.applicability: positive delivery requires handler/payload/receipt/state; absent or different mode requires no-delivery; invalid input requires INVALID_INPUT and no-delivery; preservation always applies
F-X.negative_observation_end: worker termination plus drained/cancelled owned pending deliveries and declared receiver boundary
F-X.persistence_claim: process-restart only when separately required; not power loss
